question: Fundamental Duties were included in the Indian constitution on the recommendation of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Swaran Singh Committee__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Swaran Singh Committee is related to the Fundamental Duties in India.
 
• On the recommendation of the Swaran Singh Committee, 11 Fundamental Duties were added to the Indian Constitution.
 
• Article 51A deals with the Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution were added by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act 1976.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• The Fundamental Duties are set out in Part IVA of the Constitution of India.
 
• The Fundamental Duties are statutory duties and are not enforceable by law.
 
• The Constitution of India adopted the Fundamental Duties from the Constitution of Russia (former USSR).
 
• The Fundamental Duties were added to the Constitution on the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee of 1975.
 
• The Fundamental Duties were added in the year 1976.
